name: model-catalog
description: Exposes the live VS Code language model catalog to Agent Workflow for dynamic per-job routing.

commands.title: Agent Workflow: Show Live Model Catalog

languageModelTools.name: agent-workflow_getModelCatalog
languageModelTools.displayName: Get Agent Workflow Live Model Catalog
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the live list of language models currently exposed by the VS Code Language Model API. Use before choosing a model for a subagent. It returns identity and context-capacity metadata, not a fixed quality ranking. Do not infer cost, reasoning/thinking, modality/tool suitability, latency, or quality if those fields are not returned.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the current VS Code model catalog for Agent Workflow dynamic routing.
